hints: Apply $S_n = \frac{a(r^n - 1)}{r - 1}$ with $a = p, r = 2$ to get $p(2^n - 1) > 1000p$.
walkthrough: Identify the parameters of the geometric progression: first term $a = p$, common ratio $r = \frac{2p}{p} = 2$.

Write the sum formula for the first $n$ terms:
$$S_n = \frac{p(2^n - 1)}{2 - 1} = p(2^n - 1)$$

Set up the given inequality $S_n > 1000p$ and divide by the positive constant $p$:
$$p(2^n - 1) > 1000p \implies 2^n - 1 > 1000 \implies 2^n > 1001$$

hints: For AP with $a = p, d = p$: $u_n = np = 336$ and $S_n = \frac{n}{2}(p + np) = 7224$.
walkthrough:
For the arithmetic progression with first term $a = p$ and common difference $d = 2p - p = p$, set up the $n$th term and sum equations:
$$u_n = p + (n - 1)p = np = 336$$
$$S_n = \frac{n}{2}[2p + (n - 1)p] = \frac{n}{2}(p + np) = 7224$$

Substitute $np = 336$ into the sum equation:
$$\frac{n}{2}(p + 336) = \frac{np + 336n}{2} = \frac{336 + 336n}{2} = 168(1 + n) = 7224$$
